complete_zero_meaning: Only the fictional isolated customer invoice population at the matched cutoff is declared complete; zero selected receivable and payment rows are not external proof of zero balance or good payment behavior.
incomplete_meaning: Unknown AR and overdue state; no credit or policy clearance may be inferred from empty selected lists.
known_exposure_policy: Positive quote and commitments are reported as a lower bound; whether they alone suffice for hard-cap adjudication without adopted completeness or possible offsets remains a separate author/academic decision.
legacy_intake: Unchanged; this contract does not adopt Credit v3 for Phase 1C v2 or Phase 2 runtime.
